notes.title: Removed Coins and Quests
notes.content:
Hey fam,

As you rightfuly pointed - the coins and quests didn't really fit the PC game version, so I removed it.

Hints are now time-based, and you have to wait 60s to use them again, if you ever need and feel like doing so!

I know noone does this, but hey, it's there for you in case of emergency!

Have fun playing
Cheers
Mike
